mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit for a backyard sauna in Toronto?

acceptedAnswer.text: The City of Toronto requires a building permit for accessory structures over 10 m² (about 107 sq ft), and zoning setbacks from lot lines apply to all of them. The electrical connection needs an Electrical Safety Authority permit. We check your sauna's footprint against the rules before you order.

mainEntity.name: Can you get a sauna into a backyard with a narrow side yard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, yes. Our cube saunas arrive as panels that can be carried through a side yard or gate. We confirm the narrowest point of your access during the site check and plan the delivery around it.

mainEntity.name: My lot backs onto a ravine. Is that a problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily, but ravine lots can be within the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority's regulated area. We keep the sauna on level ground away from the slope and suggest confirming with TRCA if you're close to the top of bank.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Toronto?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Toronto. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
